timeline.label: Forcing Mate

timeline.label: Intermediate Check
timeline.evidence: Bxc4+ takes the queen with check before Rxh1. Every legal answer to the check preserves extra material through the deferred capture or the piece taking the checker. Playing Rxh1 first allows Qxa6, preventing an immediate profitable capture of that queen. The move order matters, not just the two captures.
